name: AG Interior Designs
old_description: AG Interior Designs crafts high-end custom furniture, drapery, and automated window treatments for luxury homes, hotels/resorts, and commercial spaces. Proudly made in Las Vegas.
about:
AG Interior Designs was founded in 2013 in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company operates two dedicated manufacturing floors in its hometown, producing custom furniture, drapery, and automated window treatments for high-end residential and commercial projects across the western United States.

The shop specializes in handcrafted custom furniture, luxury drapery, motorized window coverings, and reupholstery services. Its output spans complete hardware solutions for window treatments and bespoke furnishings, all fabricated in-house. The facility serves designers and direct clients with projects ranging from single-room residential installations to large-scale hospitality and casino fit-outs.

Primary markets include luxury residential, hospitality (five-star resorts and world-class casinos), and exclusive commercial spaces. The company works with interior designers and high-end clients throughout Nevada, California, Arizona, Utah, and Colorado, delivering made-in-the-USA products for both new construction and renovation.

AG Interior Designs emphasizes custom craftsmanship built to each client's vision, sourcing premium fabrics, woods, and hardware. A stated differentiator is smart-home integration, particularly motorized drapery and automated window coverings, paired with a reputation for meticulous attention to detail across all project phases.
